correctness.rationale: Enumerated all proper states with an independently implemented backtracking routine from the 24-edge graph: 18,024 colourings and 64,320 Hamming-one edges. Independent adjacency traversal found two connected sectors of 9,012; evaluating the 11 oriented signed rainbow squares at all states gave exactly ±3 and no crossing Hamming-one edges. Enumerating cross-sector Hamming-distance-2 pairs gave 11,616 supported on 20 graph edges. Inspected chvatal_verifier_a.py and chvatal_verifier_b.py at exact Git blobs: program A checks graph automorphisms, 108 colour-symmetry orbits and representative BFS eccentricities (16..20), and B independently enumerates partitions and crossing pairs. Their exhaustive finite coverage is a proof method for this fixed finite graph, although the eccentricity aggregation was not independently rerun in this execution. 5-colour connectivity follows from the published Δ+1 theorem and impossibility of frozen 5-colourings because 5 does not divide 12. Domain is this specific fixed labelled finite graph, not all 4-chromatic graphs.
